data.summary: Most headline plan limits, eligibility, waiting period, COVID, cruise exclusion and benefit-table values are supported by the parsed PDS. However, there are several actionable issues: one rental vehicle limit over-includes a separate benefit, loss-of-income limits omit required basis/period details, non-traveller pre-existing-condition wording adds an unsupported acceptance exception, some uncaptured Gold-only benefits are omitted because coverage_benefits is null, and product_name values include tier names despite plan_name already carrying the tier.

findings.reason: The extracted value combines the Domestic Gold rental car excess waiver with the separate 'Return of rental car' benefit. The canonical field is for rental vehicle excess/deductible/damage liability; the $750 return-of-rental-car amount is a separate sub-benefit and is already captured in sub_limits.
findings.extracted_value: $7,500 (plus Return of rental car $750 if unfit to drive)

findings.reason: The value '$5,200' is supported by the table, but the field definition asks for the loss-of-income basis, including percentage and duration if concise. The PDS states the benefit is 75% of average monthly net income for up to 6 months, which is missing.
findings.source_quote: 75% of your average monthly net of tax income that you lose for up to a maximum of 6 months

findings.reason: The value '$10,400' is supported by the table, but the field definition asks for the loss-of-income basis, including percentage and duration if concise. The PDS states the benefit is 75% of average monthly net income for up to 6 months, which is missing.
findings.source_quote: 75% of your average monthly net of tax income that you lose for up to a maximum of 6 months

findings.reason: The extraction says pre-existing conditions of a non-travelling relative/companion may be covered if 'specifically accepted'. The cited PDS wording for non-traveller/travelling-companion pre-existing conditions states these claims are not covered; the acceptance/screening pathway is stated for insured persons' own pre-existing conditions. The same wording appears across all product records.
findings.source_quote: will not cover any claims ... from any pre-existing medical condition ... affects: – a relative who is not travelling with you; – your travelling companion
findings.extracted_value: Section A/C pre‑departure cancellation/Additional emergency expenses will not cover pre‑existing conditions of a non‑travelling relative/companion (unless specifically accepted). COVID-19 cancellation for close relatives only if life‑threatening diagnosis after purchase.

findings.reason: coverage_benefits is null, but International Gold includes benefits not captured by the major fields, such as Resumption of journey, Airline hijack and Pet care. These should be represented in coverage_benefits or another suitable field to avoid benefit omissions.
findings.source_quote: C2 Resumption of journey ... $3,000 ... Airline hijack ... $2,500 ... Pet care ... $600

findings.reason: coverage_benefits is null, but Domestic Gold includes benefits not fully captured as primary coverage benefits, including Resumption of journey and Special Events. Special Events appears only as a sub_limit and Resumption of journey appears omitted.
findings.source_quote: C2 Resumption of journey ... $3,000 ... C3 ... Special Events ... $5,000

findings.reason: The product_name includes the plan tier 'Bare Essentials' even though plan_name already identifies the tier and the field definition says to exclude individual plan tier where possible. The same pattern appears across the product records.
findings.source_quote: a Level of cover i.e. Bare essentials, Silver or Gold
findings.extracted_value: Insure&Go International Single Trip Bare Essentials
